validation.queries: prepared; coordinator must validate syntax and inspect native ingestion after deployment, without fabricated production events

dashboard.name: Pitchcrew Website Heatmaps & Friction
dashboard.description: One-page public landing interaction dashboard. Native coordinate maps, observed scroll reach and heuristic rage/dead clicks. No private app recording, DOM text, element identity or raw current URLs.

insights.name: Native website interaction volume
insights.description: Counts individual native heatmap rows by day and signal; not SDK batch counts. Observed behavior only, not confirmed frustration.

source.query:
SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, type AS signal, count() AS interactions
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type IN ('click', 'rageclick', 'deadclick')
GROUP BY day, signal
ORDER BY day, signal

insights.name: Website desktop click hotspots
insights.description: Native coordinate hotspots for desktop viewports. Geometry only; manually compare with the public page because element text/autocapture is excluded.

source.query:
SELECT round(x / nullIf(viewport_width, 0), 2) AS relative_x, y * scale_factor AS page_y_px, pointer_target_fixed AS fixed, count() AS clicks
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type = 'click'
  AND viewport_width * scale_factor >= 768
GROUP BY relative_x, page_y_px, fixed
ORDER BY clicks DESC
LIMIT 20

insights.name: Website mobile click hotspots
insights.description: Native coordinate hotspots below 768 CSS pixels viewport width; separate layout from desktop.

source.query:
SELECT round(x / nullIf(viewport_width, 0), 2) AS relative_x, y * scale_factor AS page_y_px, pointer_target_fixed AS fixed, count() AS clicks
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type = 'click'
  AND viewport_width * scale_factor < 768
GROUP BY relative_x, page_y_px, fixed
ORDER BY clicks DESC
LIMIT 20

insights.name: Website possible frustration hotspots
insights.description: Native rage/dead-click heuristics. Repeated clicks or absent visible response do not prove a bug; false positives are possible.

source.query:
SELECT type AS signal, round(x / nullIf(viewport_width, 0), 2) AS relative_x, y * scale_factor AS page_y_px, count() AS observations
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type IN ('rageclick', 'deadclick')
GROUP BY signal, relative_x, page_y_px
ORDER BY observations DESC
LIMIT 20

insights.name: Website observed scroll reach
insights.description: Native pageleave scroll samples. Reach = (y + viewport_height) times scale_factor. Leave delivery is best effort; absence is not zero reach.

source.query:
SELECT round((y + viewport_height) * scale_factor / 500) * 500 AS reach_px_bucket, count() AS observations
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type = 'scrolldepth'
GROUP BY reach_px_bucket
ORDER BY reach_px_bucket

limitations: Geometry-only maps; no element text or DOM chains
Website usage opt-out and DNT exclude observations
Heatmap table cannot filter renderer/version: exact fixed homepage URL scopes all tiles
Native heatmap retention is 90 days; dashboard is last 30 days
Heatmap rows may not appear until deployed and native project capture is enabled
